texts.zh:
你们对保存异星奇景的付出无与伦比。

一般来说，我们会将一件最宝贵的文物交付给你们保管，但星系里的其他人已经捷足先登了。

作为安慰，你们也可以从这些物品中选择一个。
texts.en:
Your devotion to the preservation of Xeno Geology is nearly unmatched.

Normally, we would entrust you with one of our most precious artifacts, but others in the galaxy have come before you to claim them.

As consolation, you can take one of these items.

texts.zh:
我们城邦的遗孤得知你们建造了一座博物天枢，可以同时容纳大量的观众。与所有寻求这方面知识的人分享我们星系的历史，这是一个值得赞扬的倡议。我们在这方面志同道合。

我们希望能帮助你们实现这一目标。尽管我们已经四分五裂，但仍会尽我们最后的余力来帮助你们充实收藏。
texts.en:
The last remnants of our order have received information that you have built a Grand Archive capable of supporting attendance on a massive scale. This is a commendable initiative in sharing our galaxy's history with all who seek such knowledge. We share common goals in this respect.

We are interested in helping you pursue this endeavor. Though our order has been recently shattered, we will use our remaining assets to provide assistance as you expand your Collection.

我们希望能帮助你们实现这一目标。继续充实你的收藏，我们将会尽己所能提供帮助。
texts.en:
We have received information that you have built a Grand Archive capable of supporting attendance on a massive scale. This is a commendable initiative in sharing our galaxy's history with all who seek such knowledge. We share common goals in this respect.

We are interested in helping you pursue this endeavor. Continue to expand your Collection, and we will in turn offer our support however we can.

label.en: Very well.
